# ONNX ASR

> A lightweight Python package for Automatic Speech Recognition using ONNX models with minimal dependencies.

It supports Python 3.10 to 3.14 and runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS with various accelerators. The package loads models from Hugging Face or local directories and provides a typed API and CLI.

## Docs

- [ONNX ASR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/README.md): Overview of the onnx-asr package, its key features, supported models, and quick start installation instructions.
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/installation.md): Installation from PyPI, ONNX Runtime package options, supported platforms, and minimum dependency version requirements.
- [Usage Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/usage.md): Code examples for loading models and recognizing audio, plus a list of supported model names.
- [Community Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/community-models.md): Community-published models on Hugging Face, including language fine-tunes, OpenVoiceOS families, and optimized variants.
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Hardware specifications, RTFx metric definition, and performance benchmarks for Russian and English ASR models.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common issues with model downloads, loading, audio formats, and performance, plus guidance on getting help.
- [Comparison with Original Implementations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/comparison.md): Benchmark results for Russian and English ASR models against original implementations on CPU and GPU.
- [Convert Model to ONNX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/conversion.md): Instructions for exporting NeMo, GigaAM, Whisper, and Wav2Vec2 models to ONNX format with configuration details.
- [API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istupakov/onnx-asr/main/docs/reference.md): Documentation for onnx_asr classes, loaders, adapters, and utility functions including error handling and session options.
